cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 61% of energy names green

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Renewables & Solar lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +4.12%; weakest is Renewables & Solar at -0.53%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: BE is the standout at +7.30%
cards.body: Leaders: BE +7.30%, GEV +5.32%, VRT +4.47%, AR +3.49%, DINO +3.45%. Laggards: EOSE -5.78%, SEDG -5.06%, ENPH -4.25%, RUN -4.09%.
